Phoenix continuous rig

Asset: phoenix-rig.png, generated with built-in imagegen using the earlier phoenix-atlas.png as a style reference. Original saved image copied unchanged, RGBA 1254x1254, four 627x627 anatomical cells. Transparent pixels preserved. Cells: body/head, near wing, far wing, tail. Runtime anchors are calibrated in a normalized 512-unit cell; shoulder roots remain fixed while mesh vertices deform.

Research (not incorporated):
https://opengameart.org/content/phoenix-reborn — CC0, 32x32 sprite-sheet phoenix by Chasersgaming.
https://opengameart.org/content/jrpg-bird-procedurally-animated — CC0, 128x128 pixel/low-resolution bird animations by illin.
These did not fit the established painted artwork, so the implementation uses original modular art and code-native animation. No third-party sprite sheet was included.

Exact image-generation prompt:
Use the referenced phoenix sheet ONLY as a visual style reference. Create a NEW 2D GAME ANIMATION RIG PARTS ATLAS with exactly FOUR ISOLATED ANATOMICAL CUTOUTS arranged in a precise TWO-COLUMN TWO-ROW grid, 1024x1024 image, each 512x512 cell. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND everywhere between and around every part, no glow halos, no background or checkerboard, no text. This is NOT an animation sprite sheet: each cell contains a DIFFERENT DETACHED BODY PART for one same right-facing phoenix. Elegant rich painted feathers in amber gold, ember orange, ivory highlights and crimson tips, shaded dimensional detail, clean silhouette, no pixel art. CELL TOP LEFT: ONLY the phoenix torso, long curved neck, noble head with small crest, hooked beak pointing RIGHT and small folded feet; NO WINGS, NO long tail plumes. Torso center around (300,260) within cell; beak toward (455,220); tail socket near (140,290); all parts fit with at least25px transparent padding. CELL TOP RIGHT: ONLY one isolated large NEAR WING, fully unfurled natural bird wing with layered gold coverts, long ivory-gold primary feathers ending in ember-red tips. Shoulder attachment at cell(410,430), wing sweeps diagonally UP and LEFT into a broad elegant feather fan toward (70,65), all feathers within cell. No body, no head, no tail. CELL BOTTOM LEFT: ONLY the matching FAR WING, same orientation and same shoulder attachment cell(410,430), slightly narrower fan, darker copper-gold shading for depth; no bird body/head. CELL BOTTOM RIGHT: ONLY long flowing phoenix TAIL PLUMES, six elegant sinuous crimson-gold feathers with ivory hot cores, attached together near upper-right at cell(430,150), trailing LEFT and gently DOWN toward (45,400); no body or wings. Every cutout must be fully visible and completely separated from all other cells. Match the character identity, luminous painterly feather quality and sophisticated shading of the reference. These fixed anatomical parts will be continuously mesh-deformed and joint-animated in a game.

Animation: fixed body and head, spring-damped shoulder/elbow/wrist joints, feather lag, tail velocity filtering, and smoothly folded Boost/glide poses. Rig and effects inspected in the mobile game and enlarged production-component preview. A six-second preview was recorded directly from the WebGL canvas. Existing energy/collision rules are unaffected.
